ops.title: Codex port sealed: source accepted, live rollout pending
ops.body:
REPLY_FILE: /tmp/codex-port-handoff.txt

Source implementation, component verification, and final staging are complete. The source changes are uncommitted; live installation and publication have not run. The sealed candidate is source-ready and deployable=false.

The approved plan is cc-notes `486d766f6a2568cfe7eb6eb59442b6480baecacf` in the captain-hook checkout. Orca run `run_678003bd88ca` holds the task history. The accepted final staging record is cc-notes `abd07f7`. The approved plan remains pending live rollout.

The implementation adds a shared capt-hook host core and Rust-owned Codex transcript normalization. Each frontend connects through a local broker to one app-server per account home. Codex creates or resumes its thread normally; the broker binds the returned identity before forwarding success. cc-present feedback follows the bound thread and attachment generation.

| Component | Verified outcome | Evidence |
| --- | --- | --- |
| cc-transcript | Final `14.19.0+codex.6` wheel passed Rust, Python, Swift, and build checks. Incremental cursors and unknown native inputs retain their documented semantics. | [Implementation](/tmp/codex-port-fix-transcript-review.txt), [review](/tmp/codex-port-review-transcript.txt) |
| capt-hook | Exact `12.51.0+codex.5` wheel and universal helper match protocol 2. Full make, installed artifact checks, 4,661 Python tests, Go race tests, and 27 Swift tests pass; one tutorial recording test is skipped. | [Final build](/tmp/codex-port-final-build.txt), [identity review](/tmp/codex-port-review-hook-identity.txt), [order diagnosis](/tmp/codex-port-hook-order-diagnosis.txt) |
| Shared broker | Native binding, queued notification recovery, environment filtering, and feedback checks pass. Exact Codex 0.155.1 and 0.156.1 admission is validated. | [Broker review](/tmp/codex-port-rereview-final.txt), [runtime proof](/tmp/codex-port-interact-01561.txt) |
| Native CLI and Orca terminals | Fresh binding, Orca resume, feedback acknowledgment, and native approval passed on 0.155.1. Independent 0.156.1 terminal binding and model response passed. | [CLI and Orca](/tmp/codex-port-terminal-smoke-final.txt), [0.156.1](/tmp/codex-port-terminal-01561-final.txt) |
| cc-present | Real interaction requests, database events, and server-sent events delivered idle and active feedback to the native model once each. | [Final proof](/tmp/codex-port-present-live-final.txt), [isolation and restart proof](/tmp/codex-port-present-live.txt) |
| codex-ask | Current binding lookup works without a generation variable. Exact identity and explicit stale-generation checks remain enforced. The corrected binary passed independent native shell verification. | [Fix](/tmp/codex-port-native-owner-fix.txt), [review](/tmp/codex-port-native-owner-review.txt) |
| ccx | Native tool discovery and policy revocation checks pass. Revocation failures discard stale tool access. | [Fix](/tmp/codex-port-fix-ccx-revocation.txt), [review](/tmp/codex-port-rereview-final.txt), [lint diagnostics](/tmp/codex-port-ccx-final-lint.txt) |
| ccn and consumer tools | Session identity, patch preimages, review ownership, and orchestration interfaces passed their component checks. | [ccn](/tmp/codex-port-fix-ccn.txt), [consumers](/tmp/codex-port-fix-consumers.txt) |
| Plugin fleet | Final isolated ingestion passed for 28 native packages, 59 skills, and 20 untrusted hook definitions. All five local MCP checks, all 36 Claude installer calls, and 19 installed binary hash comparisons passed. Full Claude catalogs are preserved. | [Fleet](/tmp/codex-port-fix-fleet.txt), [skills](/tmp/codex-port-fix-hook-skills.txt), [standalone tools](/tmp/codex-port-fix-standalones.txt) |
| Monorepo | Seven policy hooks and shared guidance are staged in a separate checkout. The final installed-wheel review passed 273 host replays and six test methods. | [Report](/tmp/codex-port-monorepo.txt), [guarded rollout map](/tmp/codex-port-monorepo-rollout.json) |
| Desktop | Required account routing is present on 0.156.1. An isolated desktop reached its composer, but GUI thread creation, resume, approval, and feedback remain unverified. | [Diagnosis](/tmp/codex-port-desktop-compat.txt) |

The immutable bundle is [candidate-3](/Users/yasyf/Code/codex-port-staging/candidate-3). Its [stage report](/Users/yasyf/Code/codex-port-staging/candidate-3/evidence/stage-report.txt) records package provenance and evidence; its [rollout recipe](/Users/yasyf/Code/codex-port-staging/candidate-3/recipes/rollout-commands.txt) contains installation, backup, and rollback commands. Coordinator verification passed all 10,958 sealed files. Package replay reproduced the frozen payloads. Keep this directory at its exact path because Python entrypoints use absolute shebangs.

Every expected worker has settled. The final worker was released; the run has zero active dispatches and zero reclaimable terminals. Ten historical release attempts retain an unknown disposition after supported recovery; no unrelated terminal was closed. Rejected capt-hook `codex.3` and `codex.4` artifacts must not be installed. The accepted selector is `/tmp/codex-port-bin/codex-ask-native-owner`, SHA-256 `ce2e25bfe344c8b4afbf1fb75cbb0447180368fe3a79287816a0952bb0fa6975`.

Generated hooks move once from installation-dependent counter keys to stable author-relative keys. A capped hook may therefore fire once more in an existing session after upgrade. Later installation moves preserve the new key. Ordinary handlers and internal callbacks keep their prior identities.

A lost feedback acknowledgment remains uncertain while a native turn is active because the runtime cannot yet return its history. The bridge reports that error without resending; after completion, existing history reconciliation records delivery without duplication. Native owner lookup also needs permission to write its registry lock; the read-only sandbox probe correctly denied that write.

The matching protocol-2 helper needs Developer ID signing assets and provisioning profiles that were unavailable. An unsigned helper build cannot replace the installed signed helper. The live runtime choice remains pending, as does clarification of the desktop app location. An isolated desktop launch triggered its updater; `/Applications/Codex.app` later disappeared and a newer bundle was found in Trash. The evidence does not establish who moved it, and no restoration has run.

Actual `~/Code/monorepo`, global tool links, plugin configuration, and live daemons remain unchanged by the rollout. Authenticated Datadog behavior and graphical notifications remain unverified. Component reports retain the transcript type diagnostics, ccx lint diagnostics, and the custom client root-change limitation. Local Go workspaces and exact Python candidate wheels supply the unpublished cross-repository dependencies.

Coordination used the [Orca orchestration skill](/Users/yasyf/.agents/skills/orchestration/SKILL.md).
